decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical wrapper exporting generated yes/no country characters.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
DOS MSDOSME includes DOSMES, which includes this wrapper and generated msdos.cl3.

The existing generated candidate defines Y, N, y and n; review 060 reports the first 120 DOS message bytes match the inferred target range, while review 071 identifies the four NLS symbol relocations.
A targeted lexical search found no NT/BOP markers.
limitations: The generated message inputs and symbol addresses still require final provenance and link verification; retaining this wrapper does not establish whole kernel identity.
